resources.string: ARON checks that you are at the outlet before attendance and every sale. Without location permission these cannot start. Selling and memos stay on this phone; nothing else is affected.
Location is switched off on this phone. Turn it on to check in and to sell.
The camera is used only to take the outlet photo when you press the shutter. It is never on in the background.
Bluetooth is used only to connect to the memo printer. Without it the sale still saves; you can print the memo later.
Open Settings, tap Permissions, and set Location to \"Allow only while using the app\" with Precise location on. Then come back to ARON.
Open Settings, tap Permissions, and set Camera to \"Allow only while using the app\". Then come back to ARON.
Open Settings, tap Permissions, and allow Nearby devices. Then come back to ARON.
ARON needs your precise location to check that you are at the outlet. Approximate location is not enough: allow precise location.
